# Closed superclass constructor arguments

Owned Java 25 constructor computes an original long and conditional callback
arguments before its exact superclass call. All generic argument types are closed;
no type variable or argument inference is available. Ordinary Java 8 declarations
are compiled separately for the SDK route. The immutable observer checks callback
identity, long word preservation, branch order, partial construction state, nulls,
exact failures and callback result cast timing. Every generated Java file and
original metadata/Exceptions entry must compile and match.
